criteria: Directly answers the specific question asked, addressing both the empirical/practice and political-theory components where the question draws on both

Prelims_Politics.pass_threshold: Answers four questions overall, at least one from Section A and two from Section B (the paper's own rule), directly answers the question asked, states and defends a clear position, and connects empirical mechanism to theoretical principle rather than treating them separately.
